logical_reasoning.question: Five developers complete a project in 10 days. How many days will ten developers take?
logical_reasoning.answer: 10 days because there are more developers working.

logical_reasoning.question: A sequence is 2, 4, 8, 16. What is the next number?

scenario_evaluation.question: Your website is not loading. What would you do?
scenario_evaluation.answer: I will refresh the page and check the internet connection. If it still does not work, I will ask a senior developer.
